text:
Maya (Growth): Short sync: we need final copy for the tri-mode landing pages + a webinar signup flow that captures mode intent and token estimates. Goal: drive demo requests for Dedicated/Private and self-serve activation for Hosted.
Jon (PMM): Agreed. Draft launch post angle: "Serving first, models second". Lead with the problem (unpredictable latency/cost) then funnel to mode pages. Keep the blog short with an embedded webinar CTA.
Rae (Content): Hero lines per page: Hosted: "Prototype fast, ship today." Dedicated: "Committed throughput, SLA-backed." Private: "Inference in your network." Subheads: one-liners about latency, predictability, compliance.
Kai (Design): I'll produce three hero comps and a shared benchmark rack. Avoid specific raw numbers on public pages; use "verified profiles" copy and gated kit for details. Also creating A/B art: speed vs cost.
Omar (Sales Ops): Routing: Hosted CTAs -> nurture + product emails; Dedicated CTAs -> AE queue Enterprise-Reserved; Private CTAs -> security form then AE. Add hidden CTA param mode_hint to capture clicks. Webinar reg add fields: mode_interest, monthly_tokens_bucket, primary_use_case.
webinar-bot: Reminder: publishing the webinar page will create HubSpot campaign id tri_mode_launch_2026 and append utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch to demo CTA links.
Rae (Content): CTA microcopy suggestions: Hosted: "Start free — no card"; Dedicated: "Reserve capacity — talk to sales"; Private: "Request private eval — security first". Also micro-bullets under hero: latency | cost control | deployment modes.
Jon (PMM): Benchmark narrative: public page = teaser ("verified performance profiles"); gated kit + webinar show p50/p95 and throughput methodology. Use webinar to show reproducible plots.
Maya (Growth): A/B test plan: Run headline A/B on Hosted + Dedicated for 10 days. Primary metric = demo clicks / webinar signups. Secondary = activation rate for hosted.
Kai (Design): Will tag components with tracking IDs; push comps by EOD. Rae, keep verbs consistent across modes to simplify A/B.
Omar (Sales Ops): After copy freeze I'll map CTA ids to HubSpot workflows and set AE slack alerts for Dedicated/Private signups within 4 hours.
Maya (Growth): Timeline: copy freeze tomorrow 11am PT, design comps by 6pm, QA Wed, soft launch Thursday. I'll publish final runbook here after freeze. :white_check_mark:
